title: The vocabulary of the game (content/rules/vocabulary.json, schema v0)
description: The words of the game that are not in the definitions of the cars, the parts, the cities and the tracks: the names of the slots and the stats, the weather, the rarities, the places of the menu, and the sentences of the screens. The web app brings its own text for every message, so this document holds only what a pack says differently (what is not here is the text that the app has), and a game about ships is a pack that says 'hull' where the app says 'tires'. Every message is named by its key in the web app (slot.tires, nav.garage) or, for what the server says to a driver, by the key of its text in lang/<language>/game.php with the prefix server. (server.game.errors.no_run); its names are written {name} in the web app and :name on the server. It has the text in the languages of the game; English and Polish are required, and a language that is missing falls back to the English of the pack, not to the text of the app.

messages.description: The texts by the key of the message. The {names} in a text are the ones of the message in the app: a text may not leave one out or add one, because the app fills them in.

text.description: A message in the product languages. English and Polish are required, the others fall back to English.
